intro.text: The king to whom Tress, disguised as a royal inspector, says she must report an attempted escape from Diggen's Point.
The king whose writs govern trade, and who is pressing merchant ships into his navy for a war with the Sorceress.
King of the Emerald Sea and perhaps more, with a palace on the king's island; Salay calls him the Verdant King.

items.text: Trade under the king requires a royal mercantile writ, and a tariff is still charged. His writs of purchase also oblige captains to carry officials who need to leave Diggen's Point.

The king opposes the Sorceress and the tolls she charges on trade through the Midnight Sea, and nearly everything he is said to do is aimed against her: he sent Charlie to her and has been seizing merchant ships for his navy to fight her.

His law kept the people of Diggen's Point from leaving their island. Once the Sorceress had been beaten, he changed it: they may now go as they please, and those who stay twenty years are paid handsomely.
